reviews.text:
Quite possibly the most unorganized and poorly run contractor "business" priding themselves in ridglea hills neighborhood. They did a huge reno for us not even two years ago and not only went from a sold 3 month time frame to almost a year due to THEIR mishaps, "miscommunications" and literally just not listening to our concerns and requests. People abruptly quitting lead design role in their company during the renovation resulting in even more delays is quite unprofessional - especially when you cannot cover your tracks and step in to do the job properly when you have already been paid. That being said, it's been almost two years. The exterior paint they used is PEELING off ... what? And why? We have a 75 year old home and that paint is holding strong yet a barely
Two year paint job mysteriously can't handle a little wind, season, or temperature change? The cracks and shotty Sheetrock and paint work done interior were so bad my husband and I were so sick of dealing with these people and their constant excuses we just let it go to hire new people to come fix it all. It took me two years to write this because we will have to move soon and again will have to go back and REdo the (poorly fixed) wall cracks, caulking and and exterior paint that is business was paid to do. Wont mention names because she lives in the neighborhood. Writing this so others aren't swooned by their big promises and lack of accountability. Keep shopping around for your home!
reviews.author: Hayley

reviews.text: B Smart Builders remodeled our house 4 years ago. I LOVE the results. They provide detailed bids, multiple design options, and had someone on my job every single day. 2 years ago I started working for the company. Each team member is kind, highly ethical, honest, and fun to work with.

data.summary: The reviews appear largely authentic. The business has a long, established history with a strong BBB profile. The single, detailed 1-star review on Google raises credible concerns about project management and communication, which are common contractor complaints. The positive reviews are generic but not overtly fake. The low overall review count, especially on Google, makes a definitive assessment of review authenticity more challenging but does not indicate manipulation.
fake_signals: Low review volume on primary platforms limits pattern analysis
One Google review is from a current employee, which is a potential bias
authentic_signals: Specific, detailed complaint from a recent customer with named issues (Ridglea Hills project, design lead quitting)
Business has long tenure (16 years) and BBB accreditation since 2011
Mix of positive and negative reviews across platforms
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistent across Google (4.2), Yelp (4.4), and Houzz (4.6). BBB A+ rating with no complaints indicates good business practices. Low review volume on Google (5) vs. Yelp (31) is a data availability issue, not a discrepancy in sentiment.
